description: Normalization silently collapses two distinct header entries when both spellings exist.
trigger: A scanned safetensors header contains both mapped spellings with different descriptors.
expected_behavior: An ambiguous collision should be rejected or explicitly resolved rather than silently discarding the canonical descriptor.
actual_behavior: read_header deletes the legacy key and unconditionally overwrites the canonical key with its descriptor. Collection override accounting cannot report this within-header collision because it sees only the normalized header.

verification.description: Transcribed normalization selected the legacy descriptor when both keys were supplied.
verification.limits: Synthetic dictionary only; no affected checkpoint established. Reach is the inspected add_tensor_files → read_header path, not a demonstrated model failure.
